newsitem.title: CHINA: China urges people to rally to party after Deng.
newsitem.headline: China urges people to rally to party after Deng.

text.p: China called on its people on Thursday to rally behind the ruling Communist Party and its chief, Jiang Zemin, after the death of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

"We must uphold and safeguard party unity and unification, unite more conscientiously around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin at the core," said an official obituary issued by the Xinhua news agency.

"The death of Comrade Deng Xiaoping is an immeasurable loss to our Party, our army and the people of various ethnic groups throughout the country, and will certainly cause tremendous grief among the Chinese people," the obituary said.
Deng died on Wednesday night of respiratory failure. He was in the late stages of Parkinson's disease and had a lung infection.
"Eternal glory to Comrade Deng Xiaoping!" the obituary said.
